ios.desc:
you know what you should be doing. you're not doing it.

here's the fix: pick a rival. pick a habit. put real money on the line. check in with a photo. your rival decides if it counts.

miss your week? you pay them. they miss? they pay you.

that's the whole app. it works because losing to a friend hurts more than skipping.

---

HOW IT WORKS:

1. pick a rival. or a group.
someone who won't let you slide. pull them from your contacts or type a name. or dare three to six people at once.

2. pick the habit
gym, running, reading, meditation, studying, cooking, journaling, yoga, worship. or quitting something: sugar, smoking, social media, drinking. or name your own.

3. set the stake
$5? $50? $500? pick the number that gets you off the couch.

4. send the dare
one link. text it, whatsapp it, drop it in the group chat. they can say yes from the link before they even install. rival not answering? open it up. first one to accept takes the spot.

5. start without them
check in while you wait. your rival joins already behind.

6. check in with proof
take the photo. it goes straight to your rival in the app.

7. your rival rules on it
they verify it or they call bs. no gps. no sensors. just someone who knows you. if your rival doesn't respond within 24 hours, it counts anyway.

8. settle up
sunday morning the verdict lands. loser pays the winner directly. in a group, whoever missed pays into the pot and the ones who made it split it. venmo, cash app, zelle. we never touch the money.

---

WHY IT WORKS:

money makes it real.
a goal with nothing on it is a wish.

a rival makes it personal.
you can lie to an app. you can't lie to someone holding your photo.

skipping gets expensive.
the doubler raises your stake every scheduled day you miss. one verified check-in resets it.

---

FEATURES:

- 13 habits plus your own
- stakes from $1 to $500
- run several pacts at once and switch in a tap
- group pacts for 3 to 6: miss and you pay the pot, make it and you split it
- friends can accept your dare from the link, no install needed
- daily, weekdays, weekends or custom schedules
- photo proof, shown to your rival in the app
- call bs on a check-in. they get 24 hours to defend it.
- a check-in nobody answers counts after 24 hours
- open challenges: one invite, several people, first to accept wins
- head start: check in before your rival even joins
- deadline alerts when missing today would actually cost you
- weekly verdict every sunday
- streaks and milestones
- the doubler

show_hn.title: Show HN: AccountabiliBuddy – I need someone to take my money when I skip the gym

quotes.text:
Quick background: Long time lurker, first time poster. I've never coded a mobile app before. I saw Replit came out with this feature that lets you submit straight to the App Store and figured I'd give it a shot. Built the whole thing over a couple of days in Replit and Expo.

The idea sprung up because I only actually go to the gym consistently when there's a real person who will judge me if I don't show up. Alone I'm basically a motivational poster that never moves.

So I made an app that forces me to have that person and makes skipping expensive.

It's basically loss aversion plus social pressure (which works way better than reminders for me) and I kept it super private: no tracking, no storing your selfies or videos, everything stays between you and your friend.

How it works:

- You and a friend agree on a weekly workout goal (3–6 sessions) and a stake amount ($25–$100)

- Share a unique code to connect the pact

- During the week, either of you can snap a gym selfie and send it through the app to the other person

- The other person confirms (simple yes/no) that the workout happened

- At the end of the week, if you didn't hit the agreed target you owe the stake (paid directly to your friend via Venmo/Cash App/whatever)

- Optional punishment: instead of paying, post an embarrassing video you both agreed on (stays local, never uploaded)
